title: FZJ80 - Cummins r2.8 swap
transmission: R151F Toyota 5-speed (foreign-market variant with modified tail housing)
ai_summary: Owner of a triple-locked 1995 FZJ80 is planning an R2.8 swap using an Axis/Advanced Adapters bellhousing to an overseas-spec R151F 5-speed, retaining the factory HF2A(V) full-time transfer case. The build stalled on a driveline spline-count mismatch between the transmission output and transfer case input.

complications.detail: Foreign-market R151F output shaft uses 21-23 splines while the HF2A(V) transfer case input requires 19 splines, forcing a choice between modifying the transmission output or the transfer case input, or sourcing an HZJ79/HZJ105 transmission-and-transfer-case combo
